close_reason: Added a reviewed exact-version policy for all 78 shipped applications, lock-source identities, license validation, native inventory, deterministic notices, and new-component rejection.
description:
## Outcome

Every OTP, Elixir, Hex, Git, and native component shipped in the macOS ARM64 archive has a reviewed license record and required notice text.

## Work

1. Inventory the private runtime, application dependencies, runtime data, and native libraries.
2. Record component name, version, source, license identifier, license file, and notice requirement.
3. Generate `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES` from reviewed source data.
4. Fail the local release for a missing, unknown, forbidden, or incompatible record.
5. Keep build-only tools separate from shipped files.
6. Make the audit deterministic and usable without a network call after dependencies resolve.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every shipped component maps to one reviewed license record.
- [ ] The package contains project, OTP, and third-party notices.
- [ ] The audit detects a new or changed component with no matching record.
- [ ] Source identities match the lock and build inputs.
- [ ] The local release command can run and verify the audit.

## Tests

Test complete, missing, duplicate, malformed, native-only, and changed-version inventories.

## Non-goals

Do not provide legal advice, publish, or sign the artifact.
title: Audit shipped dependencies and generate license notices
